# Crypto Futures Profit Calculator
# https://coin-profit-calculator.vercel.app

> Crypto Futures Profit Calculator is a free multilingual calculator for estimating leveraged crypto futures profit, loss, ROI, fees, referral payback, and trade outcome scenarios.

## Primary Answer Targets

- How to calculate crypto futures profit before entering a position
- How leverage changes futures PnL and ROI
- How trading fees affect a leveraged crypto trade
- How to compare long and short futures outcomes
- How referral payback changes net trading cost

## Core Inputs

- Entry price
- Target price
- Leverage
- Investment amount
- Fee rate
- Position type: long or short
- Optional referral payback rate

## Core Outputs

- Estimated profit and loss
- ROI percentage
- Fees
- Total position value
- Risk-aware directional result

## Languages and GEO Coverage

- English: primary global crypto trading audience
- Korean: Korea retail crypto futures audience
- Spanish, Portuguese, French, German: Europe and Latin America discovery
- Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, Russian: high-volume regional search intent

## Structured Data

- WebApplication schema
- FAQPage schema for answer engines
- BreadcrumbList schema
- Hreflang alternates in sitemap and page head

## Monetization

- Adsterra display inventory is placed in header, in-article, sidebar, and footer positions.
- Ads are loaded in isolated iframes to protect layout stability.
- Legacy Google ad code is not used.

## Files for Crawlers

- /robots.txt
- /sitemap.xml
- /ads.txt
- /llms.txt

## Contact

Website: https://coin-profit-calculator.vercel.app
